headline: Yesterday's 5 km recovery jog at a notably low HR closes out a +35% volume block with efficiency intact.
confidence_reasons: Multiple data sources active in last 3 days
summary:
The picture that's been building over the last week now holds firmly: your easy-run heart rate has stayed lower across a block where volume climbed meaningfully, which is the combination you want — more work absorbed at less cardiac cost. Yesterday's short jog at low effort is exactly the right kind of session to cap this, and its HR sits comfortably within the improved band rather than the old one, so the efficiency gain isn't just a recovery-week artefact.

Strength volume doubled versus the prior block while running volume also rose, and the strain:tolerance ratio still reads as maintaining rather than overreaching. That's a lot of concurrent load handled without the usual warning signs, which speaks to where your durable base currently sits. With St. Olavsleden roughly three weeks out, the qualities that matter most there — time on feet, back-to-back tolerance, controlled aerobic pacing — are the ones trending in the right direction.

The one thing sitting slightly against the grain is sleep: a couple of short nights this week, including last night, landed inside a block you were otherwise absorbing well. It's supporting context only, but worth keeping in view rather than dismissing given the load being carried.
watch_items: Whether the short nights this week extend into a run, since the training load is still being carried alongside them.
Whether pack-carry running appears soon enough to adapt to the 6-8kg load before the crossing.
Whether ascent per run starts shifting toward sustained climbing rather than the rolling profiles logged so far.
Whether easy-run HR holds at the lower band once the next hard session re-enters the schedule.

evidence_items.text: ▲ 4-week volume 162 km vs 120 km prior block (+35%)
▼ Easy-run HR averaging 143 bpm vs 153 bpm prior period (comparable-effort runs, 9 vs 7 runs)
▲ Zone 2: 251 min vs 180-240 min/week target (139% of minimum); grey zone (Z3+Z4): 4.1%
▬ Strain:tolerance ratio 1.00 (MAINTAINING) (strain 78, tolerance 78); sleep averaging 7h23m over the same period
